properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dev-only dependency of the Hardhat/Ethereum toolchain in this EIP-2535 diamond starter; the app's own JS never calls hash.js — it is reached through ethers/hardhat. Shipped in every npm install of the starter; not part of any deployed artifact.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: secp256k1 is the Ethereum signature curve — the actual transaction-signing primitive of this project's toolchain (ethers/hardhat sign and verify with it). The JS tree is dev-only; on-chain signing is done by node clients, not this repo.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: OpenSSL EVP_BytesToKey (single-iteration MD5 KDF) shipped as a browser polyfill inside the dev toolchain; no first-party call site, but the algorithm is present in every install of the starter.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: create-ecdh is the crypto-browserify ECDH polyfill; this starter performs no ECDH of its own — the scripts only call ethers/hardhat. Shipped-library capability in dev installs; migration to ML-KEM-768 applies only if any future code path exercises it.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: elliptic is the ECDSA engine behind Ethereum JS tooling (tx signing, signature recovery in tests). Dev-only; changeable by upgrading the toolchain (ethers 6 / newer ethereumjs stack), not by editing this repo's code.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: X25519 availability comes with the waffle test stack (eth-sig-util encrypt/decrypt). No first-party key agreement in this repo; recorded as a shipped-library capability, retroactively breakable class if ever exercised.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Keccak-256 is the workhorse hash of the Ethereum toolchain: transaction hashes, function selectors, address derivation. Grover-only weakness (hash, no Shor urgency). Dev-only tree; the first-party call sites (Solidity keccak256 constant, ethers getSighash) are reported as separate findings.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: scrypt-js is the password KDF for Ethereum keystore (v3) wallets — used by ethers' json-wallets for key encryption. Dev toolchain only; no first-party call site in this repo.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: tweetnacl's secretbox (XSalsa20 stream cipher + Poly1305 MAC) ships with the waffle/eth-sig-util test stack. No first-party use; recorded as shipped-library capability.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: The raw dependency record for the elliptic ECDSA library; linked to the algorithm entry so a reader references one record instead of two. Dev-only, part of the Ethereum test toolchain.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: PBKDF2 browserify KDF polyfill for the Ethereum cryptography stack; used for keystore/secret derivation if any toolchain path needs it. Dev-only dependency inventory.
